sketches.mechanism: Non-strict evaluation: a binding to bottom (`undefined`) is allowed to remain in the program as long as no later expression demands its value.
sketches.resonance: The unbearable thing can be present without ending the day, so long as no one asks it to speak.
sketches.draft:
buried = undefined

morning = 1

main = print morning

sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining: when the receiver is `nil`, the whole chain evaluates to `nil` without calling the requested operation.
sketches.resonance: Absence answers every further request by remaining absence.

sketches.mechanism: An `ensure` clause runs even when the method exits early through `return`.
sketches.resonance: Some gestures complete themselves after departure has already been chosen.
sketches.draft:
def leave
  return nil
ensure
  $door = :closed
end

leave
